canon.name: Caveman OS
canon.frame: a full screen view of Caveman OS, a made up operating system for cavemen, its interface filling the whole frame edge to edge, seen flat and straight on by a locked static camera, evenly lit
canon.still: The screen is perfectly still for the whole clip
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} thumps and kicks up a puff of stone dust
canon.arrive: {thing} crashes open {place} in a cloud of stone dust, already full of life and motion
canon.leave: {thing} crumbles into tumbling pebbles and rolls away
canon.settle: In the last second the dust settles, everything comes to rest and the screen holds steady as a clean sharp picture, every icon and button in its place
canon.ambient: Low wind moves outside a cave over soft room tone
canon.lettering: rough hand carved capitals cut shallow into the surface, pale and dusty
canon.style: flat digital screen capture, stone greys, ochre

filler: Every surface is flat and front facing, like a real desktop screenshot
Edges are crisp and colors are solid and even
The stone textures are fine grained and sharp
All lettering is carved by hand, shallow pale grooves in rough capitals
The lighting is flat and even from corner to corner
The whole picture is sharp and steady
The carved icons cast small soft shadows on the stone
Each icon sits on a clean patch of wallpaper with even spacing
The slate taskbar has a smooth matte surface with a thin lighter rim
The ochre paintings are faded and soft behind everything else
The colors are warm greys, tans and soft orange
The screen fills the frame edge to edge with a steady exposure
Lettering is small and carved, with plenty of bare stone around every word
The framing stays fixed on the whole screen from start to end
